decisions.decision: No income tax states (WA TN WY SD NV FL TX): omit income tax category
AZ income tax dropped sharply FY2024 (flat 2.5% vs prior progressive)
MA Millionaires Tax surtax starts FY2024 +.5-2B/yr
AL: treat ETF+GF as combined General Fund
LA: income tax cut to 3% flat FY2024; show drop in income tax line
CO: TABOR limits GF appropriations; show income tax as largest revenue
MN: added 10.85% bracket on income >$1M starting FY2024 — split as separate line item
OR: no sales tax; Corporate Activity Tax (CAT) introduced FY2020 as growing revenue
OK: oil/gas gross production tax as separate revenue category (significant/volatile)
CT: Pass-Through Entity (PTE) tax as separate line ~$1.8-2.2B/yr
UT: income tax (4.65% flat) constitutionally dedicated to education since 2020
IA: income tax cut from graduated 8.53% max → 4.82% (FY2024) → 3.8% flat (FY2026)
NV: no income tax; gaming taxes + Modified Business Tax (payroll) + sales tax
AR: income tax cut 5.9%→4.9%(FY2023)→3.9% flat(FY2024); corporate 5.9%→4.3%
MS: income tax phaseout 5%→4%→3%→0% wages; highest sales tax rate 7%
KS: income tax 2-bracket 3.1%/5.7%; top reduced to 5.58% in FY2024
